# Data Source: tfe_admin_smtp_settings

Reads SMTP settings for Terraform Enterprise. Only applies to Terraform Enterprise and requires admin token configuration.

## Example Usage

```go
import constructs "github.com/aws/constructs-go/constructs"
import "github.com/hashicorp/terraform-cdk-go/cdktf"
/*Provider bindings are generated by running cdktf get.
See https://cdk.tf/provider-generation for more details.*/
import "github.com/aws-samples/dummy/gen/providers/tfe/provider"
import "github.com/aws-samples/dummy/gen/providers/tfe/dataTfeAdminSmtpSettings"
type myConvertedCode struct {
	TerraformStack
}

func newMyConvertedCode(scope Construct, name *string) *myConvertedCode {
	this := &myConvertedCode{}
	cdktf.NewTerraformStack_Override(this, scope, name)
	/*Terraform Variables are not always the best fit for getting inputs in the context of Terraform CDK.
	    You can read more about this at https://cdk.tf/variables*/
	adminToken := cdktf.NewTerraformVariable(this, jsii.String("admin_token"), &TerraformVariableConfig{
		Description: jsii.String("An admin access token"),
	})
	hostname := cdktf.NewTerraformVariable(this, jsii.String("hostname"), &TerraformVariableConfig{
		Default: jsii.String("app.terraform.io"),
		Description: jsii.String("The HCP Terraform or Enterprise hostname."),
	})
	token := cdktf.NewTerraformVariable(this, jsii.String("token"), &TerraformVariableConfig{
		Description: jsii.String("An access token"),
	})
	provider.NewTfeProvider(this, jsii.String("tfe"), &TfeProviderConfig{
		hostname: hostname.stringValue,
		token: token.stringValue,
	})
	tfeAdmin := provider.NewTfeProvider(this, jsii.String("tfe_4"), &TfeProviderConfig{
		alias: jsii.String("admin"),
		hostname: hostname.stringValue,
		token: adminToken.stringValue,
	})
	dataTfeAdminSmtpSettings.NewDataTfeAdminSmtpSettings(this, jsii.String("foo"), &DataTfeAdminSmtpSettingsConfig{
		provider: tfeAdmin,
	})
	return this
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `Auth` (String) The authentication type. Valid values are `None`, `Plain`, and `Login`.
- `Enabled` (Boolean) Whether SMTP is enabled.
- `Host` (String) The hostname of the SMTP server.
- `Id` (String) The ID of the SMTP settings. Always `Smtp`.
- `Port` (Number) The port of the SMTP server.
- `Sender` (String) The sender email address.
- `Username` (String) The username used to authenticate to the SMTP server.
